passages.text: “When a man is always mindful, knowing moderation in eating, his discomfort fades, and he ages slowly, taking care of his life.”
“Victory breeds enmity; the defeated sleep badly. The peaceful sleep at ease, having left victory and defeat behind.”
A killer creates a killer; a conqueror creates a conqueror; an abuser creates abuse, and a bully creates a bully. And so as deeds unfold the plunderer is plundered.”
Good friends, companions, and associates are the whole of the spiritual life.
As cool water in an uninhabited region evaporates when not drunk; so too when a reprobate acquires wealth, they neither use it themselves nor give it away.
